name: Dissolution Chamber
description: An Arcanist laboratory for deconstructing and reorganising your spell repertoire.

tiers.description: Basic deconstruction. Unlocks card disenchanting. Slotting cards costs 30 gold.
Refined formulae. +5 splinters per disenchant. Slotting cards costs 20 gold.

Master deconstruction. +10 splinters per disenchant. Slotting cards costs 10 gold. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. Thin Deck: a deck may run on 7 cards, and a deck of exactly 7 draws an extra card on the first turn. Or Transmutation: turn a card into another of its school and rarity.

doctrines.name: Thin Deck
doctrines.description: Minimalism as a strategy. The deck floor drops from 10 cards to 7, and a wizard whose deck is exactly 7 draws one extra card on the first turn of every fight.

doctrines.name: Transmutation
doctrines.description: A reroll engine. At the deck editor, turn a card into a random other unlocked card of the same school and rarity, for the splinters its rarity would pay on disenchanting. Its upgrades come back as splinters.
